author: Kruggsmash
description:
*An edited, illustrated and narrated playthrough of the game Dwarf Fortress*

 Today we delve..far..too..deep! Would like to put this siege update to a hardcore test and see how the equipment holds up against the ultimate threats found in Dwarf Fortress- the forces of hell!

 Come, join us for a vomit-soaked mess of carnage and glory!

Music by Ivan Duch: https://ivanduch.com/

Intro & End tunes by Topher Anselmo: https://topheranselmo.com/

Illustration Coloring by Mrs K

title: Short Forts: The Siege...from Hell
